purpose: Execute the subset of Issue #10 that is meaningful on GitHub-hosted CPU runners while preserving a strict separation from controlled-hardware publication claims.

thread_scaling.rule: Run only thread counts not exceeding the logical CPUs exposed by the runner.

competitors.correctness_rule: All normalized result digests must match builtin on the same dataset/source.
competitors.native_external_note: LAGraph/GraphBLAS and GAP remain part of the controlled-hardware phase unless immutable native builds are explicitly provisioned on the same runner.

perf_counters.rule: Counter collection is best-effort on hosted runners. Permission denial is recorded as evidence and must not fail the baseline campaign.
